name: amp
description: amp: a grill-first, autonomous workflow for Claude Code and Codex. Interview once, then spec, plan, subagent build with per-task reviews, PR, CI and merge, with the model of each task type configurable.

reviewer.title: Reviewer model
reviewer.description: Spec, plan, roadmap, task and whole-branch reviews (amp:reviewer).

implementer.title: Implementer model
implementer.description: Tasks, fix rounds 1-3, final-review and CI fixes (amp:implementer).

checker.title: Checker model
checker.description: Scoped re-review of each fix round (amp:checker).

scout.title: Scout model
scout.description: Fact-finding during grill, design and roadmap (amp:scout).

escalation.title: Escalation model
escalation.description: Fresh implementer for fix rounds 4-5 and a BLOCKED retry. inherit = the session model.

fallback.title: Fallback model
fallback.description: Re-dispatch target when a dispatch's model is unavailable (rate or usage limit, overload).
